checkoutExpiryHours.title: Unpaid checkout expires after (hours)
checkoutExpiryHours.description: How long a payer has to finish paying on the gateway page. Each gateway caps it at its own longest time.

methodOrder.title: Order of the ways to pay
methodOrder.description: Gateway ids (stripe, paypal …) and your manual method keys, in the order payers see them. The rest follow.

preferredMethod.title: Preferred way to pay
preferredMethod.description: Shown first and picked for the payer on payment links and the pay button. Empty: the first one.
